text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: BridgePoint renewal in 18 days. Procurement wants a single PO but asks for a 10% discretionary discount line and their internal vendor code on the invoice. Signer changed to Finance Dir (no SSO). Legal flagged our KMS language. Can CS own execution?
Sam Patel: I can produce a quote with toggles: base seats, true-up allowance, discount line item, and 9mo vs 12mo term. Any net terms requested?
Jordan Rivera: Procurement contact is Helen B. She said DocuSign is acceptable but needs our remit + vendor code + PO template. I asked for PR# and internal approver names.
Lee Kim: Legal review: we shouldn't remove KMS obligations but we can narrow scope in an addendum and add indemnity carveouts. I'll draft suggested addendum text.
Maya Chen: Plan: Sam create quote with toggles and the addendum note. Jordan send PO template + remit details to Helen and request PR#. Lee draft addendum. I'll coordinate and track PO status hourly.
Sam Patel: Quote uploaded: s3://quotes/bridgepoint/1769003456-quote-v1.pdf. Contains 9mo/12mo rows, discount toggle as optional line, true-up language, and KMS addendum placeholder.
OpsBot: DocuSign envelope created -> https://docusign.example/bridgepoint/zz9 (expires in 7 days). Envelope ID: DF-1769.
Jordan Rivera: Helen confirmed vendor code 4582 and said PR# will come from Procurement on Friday. She's ok with DocuSign but wants invoice remit block matching their PO. Shared their PO template in #cs-ops-docs.
Maya Chen: If PO isn't in by renewal date, propose 14-day operational grace before suspension, with outreach log requirement. Agree?
Lee Kim: Legal approves 14-day operational grace with required outreach log + signed addendum before extended access. Put exact language in quote.
Sam Patel: Noted. If procurement asks to change net terms (Net30->Net45) ping me; I can recalc ARR and update invoice dates.
Maya Chen: I'll update thread when PR# arrives and paste the signed envelope ID once completed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
